title: Continue corpus gold from source, not the scanner
description:
Keep expanding and adjudicating evaluation gold from pinned source and the concept taxonomy. Do not align the scanner in this epic.

Skill: `.agents/skills/curate-scanner-evaluation-corpus/SKILL.md`.

Locks:
- Labels describe the source; they may expose scanner defects.
- Do not use `scan()` as gold input.
- Unresolved findings stay Proposed until a person accepts a packet.
- `--apply` writes YAML only after packet accept.

First slice: the 520 Proposed corpus findings (247 data items, 273 data flows). Mentions still have unresolved YAML rows without per-label findings; that is a later slice.
